Title: Analyst, Analytics Platform and Methodology
Description:
Are you interested in joining one of Canada’s top-performing asset managers? We are looking for an Analyst to join our Platform and Methodology (PaM) team. In this position, you will help drive the digital transformation of our business by developing and modernizing our analytics platform. You will contribute across the full analytics delivery lifecycle, including methodology, design, and implementation, and work on high-impact solutions that support investment analytics across the organization.

The PaM team acts as a steward of the financial group’s analytics platform and is responsible for the delivery of post-trade and custom affiliate analytics. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a high-impact, high-skill team whose scope and impact continue to grow.

What You Will Do


Manage the end-to-end analytics production pipeline including ingestion, calculation, and distribution.
Identify, develop, source, and implement scalable analytics solutions across performance, attribution, risk, exposure, and investment models.
Support and enhance both proprietary analytics products and third-party tools such as Revolution, Bloomberg, and eVestment.
Develop and maintain dashboards and the semantic layer that supports natural language query (NLQ)
Investigate and resolve complex issues using your strong understanding of analytics methodologies.
Translate business logic and technical concepts for stakeholders, including portfolio managers and performance analysts.
Identify and implement workflow improvements that increase efficiency, reduce risk, and enhance service for stakeholders.


What You Bring


An undergraduate degree in finance, data science, or a quantitative field. Completion of a relevant designation, such as the CFA or FRM, is an asset.
You have deep knowledge in investment analytics, investment management, or data science. You are a systems thinker and take ownership of your work. Experience implementing performance and analytics systems (Revolution, BNY Data and Analytics, Simcorp Investment Analytics, etc.) is an asset.
You have practical experience with the tools and systems used in modern analytics pipelines. Experience with Python, SQL, AI programming assistants (e.g. GitHub Copilot), automation and scheduling platforms (e.g. VisualCron, Prefect), data platforms (e.g. Databricks, Microsoft Fabric), and data visualization tools (e.g. PowerBI, Tableau) is an asset. Experience developing AI solutions is an asset.
Passionate about technology and are committed to continuous learning. You apply and integrate emerging technologies where they add value. You bring the “art of the possible” to solution design.
Strong problem solver who can identify patterns, generate insights, and approach ambiguous problems with structure and creativity.
You can communicate complex concepts clearly and build alignment across stakeholders at all levels. You have a collaborative spirit, can navigate different perspectives, and promote alignment toward common organizational goals.
Identify, assess, and mitigate process risks, and escalate issues proactively when needed.
You can use judgement to make sound decisions in a timely fashion under ambiguity. You are self-directed, proactive, and comfortable proposing solutions.


The expected base salary range for this position is $85,000–$120,000. The midpoint represents our general market target for a fully qualified and experienced individual performing the role. Actual starting salary may fall below or above the midpoint depending on the candidate's relevant experience, skills and qualifications, as well as internal equity considerations. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

Your community: we foster belonging through collaboration, inclusion and flexibility. Enjoy social events, volunteering and a strong commitment to corporate social responsibility. Our flexible work practices are designed to support work-life balance and provide employees with flexibility in where and how they work
Your growth: we prioritize your development with meaningful work, continuous learning budgets, paid study days and support for professional designations.
Recognizing you: your contributions are rewarded with competitive total compensation, retirement savings support, wellness credits, enhanced parental leave, and comprehensive health benefits.


For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com.

Title: Senior Consultant, ML/AI Engineer, Data & AI
Description:
Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

Are you a technically strong and business‑oriented Machine Learning / AI Engineer with a passion for building and scaling intelligent solutions? Our team is looking for a hands‑on engineer with deep experience in AI/ML engineering and AI/ML engineering operations who can partner with clients to design, build, and operationalize AI‑powered solutions at scale.

This role will focus on translating advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI use cases into secure, scalable, and production‑ready solutions across on-prem and cloud environments (ideally on Azure but also GCP and AWS).

What You Will Do


Partner with clients to understand business problems and identify opportunities to apply AI and advanced analytics solutions.
Translate business and analytical requirements into end‑to‑end ML/AI solution design,
Execute ML/AI engineering tasks including exploratory data analysis, data preparation, model development (e.g., forecasting, classification, recommendation, anomaly detection) using tech stack such as Python and common ML frameworks (e.g., scikit‑learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Azure ML Studio, Databricks MLFlow).
Develop and optimize AI and GenAI solutions using state-of-the-art tools and platform (AI Foundry, GCP Vertex AI, AWS Sagemaker and Bedrock).
Operationalize AI/ML pipelines using AI/ML Ops best practices, including model deployment versioning, CI/CD, automated testing, and monitoring.
Implement model monitoring, performance tuning, drift detection, and retraining strategies in production environments.
Collaborate with data engineers to ensure reliable, scalable data pipelines that support model training and inference.
Apply responsible AI principles, including explainability, bias detection, model governance, and compliance with security and privacy standards.
Support client workshops, technical discussions, and stakeholder presentations related to AI strategy, solution design, and implementation.


What You Bring To The Role


University degree in computer science, engineering, data science, mathematics, or a related discipline.
3+ years of professional experience in machine learning, data science, AI engineering, or a related field, with demonstrated experience delivering production ML solutions.
Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis, machine learning, and model development.
Hands‑on experience with machine learning frameworks/libraries and platform tools (e.g., scikit‑learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Azure ML Studio, Databricks MLFlow).
Solid understanding of ML algorithms, statistics, model evaluation techniques, and feature engineering.
Experience designing and implementing end‑to‑end ML pipelines, including data preprocessing, model training, validation, deployment, and monitoring.
Practical experience with ML Ops practices, including CI/CD, model versioning, experiment tracking, and automated retraining.
Experience deploying ML models to cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) with an understanding of cloud‑native architecture and security principles.
Familiarity with big data or distributed processing frameworks (e.g., Spark) is an asset.
Experience with generative AI, large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, or retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG) is essential, experience with fine-tuning foundational models is an asset.
Strong consulting and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to collaborate within cross‑functional and multi‑disciplinary teams to solve complex business problems.


Certifications (Preferred)


Cloud AI / ML certifications (e.g., Azure AI Engineer Associate or better, AWS Machine Learning Specialty or better, Google Professional ML Engineer or better, Databricks ML Engineer Associate or better, Databricks Generative AI Engineer).

Title: Business Advisor, Data and Analytics

As a Business Advisor, Data & Analytics with Vancouver Coastal Health you will:


Examine and interpret organizational data to unlock valuable insights to inform strategic decision-making.
Support the department’s mission to enhance data-driven decision processes, identify meaningful trends, and contribute significantly to the improvement of our business operations.
Collaborate with partners across the organization to understand and gather data requirements.
Build and applies effective data models to support business objectives.
Utilize a variety of analytical tools and techniques to generate comprehensive reports and visualizations.
Analyze complex data sets to provide useful insights into business outcomes.
Contribute to the development and execution of data-driven strategies for business optimization.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity across all analytical activities.
Keep up with industry developments and innovations in data analytics and business intelligence tools.
Carry out responsibilities in accordance with health and safety requirements.
Immediately report unsafe situations by notifying supervisor or other appropriate personnel.
Perform other related duties as assigned.


This work is framed within VCH’s commitments to our pillars of Indigenous Cultural Safety, Anti-Racism, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, and Planetary Health.

The hours of work including days off and work area may be subject to change consistent with operational requirements and the provision of the Collective Agreement and applicable statutes. Successful applicants may be required to complete a Criminal Records Review Check.

As per Ministry of Health policy, all health care workers working in publicly-funded health care facilities are required to report their past receipt of certain vaccines or history of certain infections. Collecting these records will allow for offering of any missing vaccines, and for appropriate actions to be taken in the event of any future exposure to a communicable disease or during outbreaks. For all new hires and appointments to Vancouver Coastal Health, you will be asked to provide this information as part of the onboarding process.

VCH is a world class innovator in medical care, research and teaching, delivering service to more than one million BC residents. At VCH, we embrace thinking boldly, taking smart risks, and 'going first' when we believe it will lead to the best possible outcomes for patients and their families. We invite you to join us in creating healthy lives in healthy communities by showcasing our passion for care, connection to the communities we serve and our culture of teamwork that makes VCH a great place to work.


Comprehensive health benefits package, including MSP, extended health and dental and municipal pension plan
Grow your career with employer-paid training and leadership development opportunities
Wellness supports, including counselling, critical incident and innovative wellness services are available to employees and their immediate families
Award-winning recognition programs to honour staff, medical staff and volunteers
Access to exclusive discount offers and deals for VCH staff

Vancouver Coastal Health is proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers, BC’s Top Employers, Canada’s Best Diversity Employers and Canada's Top Employers for Young People in 2026.

Thank you for your interest in Vancouver Coastal Health.

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field, with a minimum of three (3) years’ recent, related experience in data analysis, business analytics, or a similar role, with a preference for experience in the healthcare sector or in organizations of comparable complexity. Proven experience in data analysis, business analytics, or a similar role.
Advanced proficiency in analytical tools and software (e.g., SQL, Python, R, Tableau, Power BI).
Knowledge of database systems like MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MS SQL
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think analytically.
Familiarity with machine learning algorithms and predictive modeling, capable of applying these techniques to forecast trends and inform strategic decisions. Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into understandable insights and recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Experience in stakeholder management, with a demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with various departments and communicate complex data insights to non-technical audiences effectively.

Physical ability to perform the duties of the position.

26WD100628, Machine Learning Developer

Position Overview

Autodesk makes software for people who make things. If you’ve ever driven a high-performance car, admired a towering skyscraper, used a smartphone, or watched great science fiction films, chances are you’ve experienced what millions of Autodesk customers are doing with our software. Autodesk's Emerging Media and Entertainment Technology division is seeking a Machine Learning (ML) Developer to work on innovative projects that help our customers imagine, design, and make a better world. This role is ideal for individuals proficient in applying ML methodologies and tools to a wide range of data and use cases.

The role is based in Toronto, Montreal or Vancouver. It is a hybrid role.

Our team is globally based, with key locations in Toronto, Montreal, San Francisco and Vancouver.

Responsibilities


Review state-of the-art media-focused, and especially motion-focused ML publications and technologies
Assess capabilities for feasibility and generalizability, and report to project and program leads
Implement cutting edge ML results, improve existing models Stay current with new ML models and AI techniques
Develop new specific as well as generalized large models for motion prediction under various modalities
Develop end-to-end workflows, leveraging new data-driven techniques and evolving motion editing technologies
Work collaboratively on research projects within a globally-based team
Support research through building experimental pipelines and prototypes
Handle data processing and preparation at scale
Conduct model training and hyperparameter tuning
Analyze model errors and design strategies for mitigation
Leverage cutting edge coding tools for high velocity. Maintain high standards of engineering, scalable implementations for shared code repos


Minimum Qualifications


MS, or PhD in a field related to AI/ML such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or a related discipline
Proficiency in Deep Learning techniques (Network architectures, regularization techniques, learning techniques, loss-functions, optimization strategies, etc.)
Deep background in statistical methods for Machine Learning (Bayesian methods, HMMs, graphical models, dimension reduction, clustering, classification, regression techniques, etc.)
Experience with multiple assisted coding environments
Strategies for best practices for high-velocity and scalable assisted code generation
Computational time-series data analytics and prediction regimes
Proficiency with scalable compute, bandwidth and storage infrastructure and associated orchestration layer
Proficiency with Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and other standard deep learning frameworks
Profound understanding of fundamental CS algorithms and their scaling behaviors
Practical experience in applying machine learning algorithms and libraries to business problems


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in production environments and creative workflows in the entertainment or adjacent industries
Proven collaboration with creatives and producers
Familiarity with media pipelines and practical application of data modeling


The Ideal Candidate


Ability to decompose large problems into manageable components and develop clear solutions
Proactive and self-motivated attitude towards problem solving
Excellent documentation skills for code and software architecture
Self-motivation and the ability to find solutions and execute problems with minimal supervision
Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to learn and adapt in newly forming areas
Outstanding visual and verbal communication skills
A passion for entertainment and skills in the use of creative software
Highly effective interpersonal skills and a growth mindset


26WD100628, Développeur en apprentissage automatique

Aperçu du Poste

Autodesk développe des logiciels destinés à ceux qui créent. Si vous avez déjà conduit une voiture haute performance, admiré un gratte-ciel imposant, utilisé un smartphone ou regardé de grands films de science-fiction, il y a de fortes chances que vous ayez déjà fait l’expérience de ce que des millions de clients d’Autodesk réalisent grâce à nos logiciels.La division « Emerging Media and Entertainment Technology » d’Autodesk recherche un développeur en apprentissage automatique (ML) pour travailler sur des projets innovants qui aident nos clients à imaginer, concevoir et créer un monde meilleur. Ce poste est idéal pour les personnes maîtrisant l’application des méthodologies et des outils d’apprentissage automatique à un large éventail de données et de cas d’utilisation.

Notre équipe est répartie dans le monde entier, avec des sites clés à Toronto, Montréal, San Francisco et Vancouver.

Responsabilités


Passer en revue les publications et technologies de pointe en ML axées sur les médias, et en particulier sur le mouvement
Évaluer la faisabilité et la généralisation des capacités, et rendre compte aux responsables de projet et de programme
Mettre en œuvre les résultats de pointe en ML, améliorer les modèles existants Se tenir au courant des nouveaux modèles de ML et des techniques d’IA
Développer de nouveaux modèles à grande échelle, tant spécifiques que généralisés, pour la prédiction de mouvement dans diverses modalités
Développer des workflows de bout en bout, en tirant parti des nouvelles techniques basées sur les données et des technologies d’édition de mouvement en constante évolution
Travailler en collaboration sur des projets de recherche au sein d’une équipe internationale
Soutenir la recherche en créant des pipelines expérimentaux et des prototypes
Gérer le traitement et la préparation des données à grande échelle
Réaliser l’entraînement des modèles et le réglage des hyperparamètres
Analyser les erreurs des modèles et concevoir des stratégies pour les atténuer
Exploiter des outils de codage de pointe pour une exécution rapide. Maintenir des normes d’ingénierie élevées et des implémentations évolutives pour les dépôts de code partagés


Qualifications Minimales


Master ou doctorat dans un domaine lié à l’IA/l’apprentissage automatique (IA/ML), tel que l’informatique, les mathématiques, les statistiques, la physique ou une discipline apparentée
Maîtrise des techniques d’apprentissage profond (architectures de réseaux, techniques de régularisation, techniques d’apprentissage, fonctions de perte, stratégies d’optimisation, etc.)
Connaissances approfondies des méthodes statistiques pour l’apprentissage automatique (méthodes bayésiennes, HMM, modèles graphiques, réduction de dimension, regroupement, classification, techniques de régression, etc.)
Expérience avec plusieurs environnements de codage assisté
Maîtrise des meilleures pratiques pour une génération de code assistée à haute vélocité et évolutive
Analyse computationnelle de séries chronologiques et régimes de prédiction
Maîtrise des infrastructures évolutives de calcul, de bande passante et de stockage, ainsi que de la couche d’orchestration associée
Maîtrise de Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch et d’autres frameworks standard d’apprentissage profond
Compréhension approfondie des algorithmes fondamentaux de l’informatique et de leur comportement à grande échelle
Expérience pratique dans l’application d’algorithmes et de bibliothèques d’apprentissage automatique à des problèmes métier


Qualifications Souhaitées


Expérience dans des environnements de production et des flux de travail créatifs dans le secteur du divertissement ou des secteurs connexes
Collaboration avérée avec des créatifs et des producteurs
Connaissance des pipelines multimédias et de l’application pratique de la modélisation des données


Le Candidat Idéal


Capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes en éléments gérables et à élaborer des solutions claires
Attitude proactive et motivée face à la résolution de problèmes
Excellentes compétences en matière de documentation du code et de l’architecture logicielle
Motivation personnelle et capacité à trouver des solutions et à résoudre des problèmes avec un minimum de supervision
Aisance face à l’ambiguïté et capacité à apprendre et à s’adapter dans des domaines en pleine évolution
Excellentes compétences en communication visuelle et verbale
Passion pour le divertissement et maîtrise des logiciels créatifs
Très bonnes compétences relationnelles et état d’esprit orienté vers le développement


Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Canada based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $110,000 and $160,600. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification

This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.

Title: Senior Research Scientist (Neural Animation)
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Creator-made content is already a proven part of EA's history — from community creation tools in Battlefield to The Gallery in The Sims 4. We believe new creative technologies and tools will expand how players engage with and contribute to our experiences, supported by thoughtful product design, safety systems, and global reach. Our focus is on enabling more players to participate in creative expression by making creation easier, safer, and more rewarding.

We are looking for a Senior Research Scientist to join our Animation research pillar and help pioneer the next generation of character animation technologies. Our goal is to build intelligent motion systems that will breathe life into future virtual characters. This is an advanced research role: you will lead the charge in translating complex neural network architectures into in-game responsive runtime behaviors, crafting high-impact simulation and generative-motion models that turn academic science into practical, expressive creations.

As a diverse team with clear goals, we provide autonomy and genuine influence to each team member. We are looking for an open and curious person; someone who gets a kick out of taking new ideas, investigating them, and adapting their application to games. You need a genuine interest in video games paired with a critical understanding of how AI can be built for games, including the ability to form your own insights on how you can improve it. You will partner with other researchers, engineers, artists, and designers. You have a desire to explore new areas of game development: someone who is passionate, creative, communicative, and invested.

This is a hybrid role, 3 days a week at our office in Redwood City (California), Montreal or Vancouver (Canada) studio.

The Senior Research Scientist will report to the Director of Research.

Responsibilities


Develop novel ideas by researching and implementing solutions to some of the most complex challenges in video game animation.
Pioneer applied research in Generative Motion, conceptualizing breakthrough algorithms and use cases that deliver expressive, player-facing animations running seamlessly on local hardware.
Build compelling demos that highlight novel solutions for character animation and locomotion with a focus on integration into modern game engine technologies.
Scientific Leadership: Share your impact by publishing your work in peer-reviewed conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR), contributing to open-source, and speaking at industry events.


Qualifications


Advanced Research Background: A degree in Computer Science, a STEM field, or equivalent practical experience related to game animation.
Technical experience: Experience with Generative Models, Computer Vision techniques (video segmentation, depth estimation, optical flow), Model training and inference.
Practical experience: Experience turning ideas into functional prototypes or demos that showcase concepts in practice.
Tooling Proficiency: Comfortable with development on Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow), game engines (Unity, Godot, Unreal, etc) and experience with agentic frameworks.
Experience & Education Requirements: Combined experience 7+ years between graduate degree research (PhD, Masters) and professional/research experience.


We are a diverse, goal-driven team that offers real influence and autonomy to every member. Our ideal candidate is curious, open-minded, and thrilled by exploring fresh concepts and tailoring them for game development. If you are a passionate, creative, and communicative individual who is deeply invested in innovating across new domains of gaming, we want you on our team.

Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$141,400 - $204,400 CAD
California (depending on location e.g. Los Angeles vs. San Francisco) *$165,000 - $256,000 USD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

In the US, we offer a package of benefits including paid time off (3 weeks per year to start), 80 hours per year of sick time, 16 paid company holidays per year, 10 weeks paid time off to bond with baby, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

Title: Data Analyst - Portfolio Reporting, Real Estate Debt
Description:
About QuadReal Property Group

QuadReal Property Group is a global real estate investment, development and operating company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. Its assets under management are $98.5 billion. From its foundation in Canada as a full-service real estate operating company, QuadReal has expanded its capabilities globally for investments in equity and debt in both the public and private markets. QuadReal invests directly through operating platforms in which it holds an ownership interest and via programmatic partnerships.

QuadReal seeks to deliver strong investment returns while creating sustainable environments that bring value to the people and communities it serves. Now and for generations to come.

QuadReal: Excellence lives here.

www.quadreal.com

Role Description:

The Data Analyst - Portfolio Reporting, Real Estate Debt (12 month Contract) will report directly to the Director, Portfolio Reporting, Real Estate Debt. We are seeking a highly motivated individual with a background in Data Science or Data Analytics who is looking to develop their career in an entrepreneurial and high-energy environment. Embedded within the business, this role supports management reporting, forecasting, and portfolio analysis across the RE Debt portfolio, in addition to being the primary liaison to ED&A and IT — translating reporting requirements into data specifications and building data flows from the Enterprise Data Platform through to the reporting layer. This position also works closely with the Real Estate Debt Investment, Accounting, and Operations teams, FP&A, and Portfolio Management teams across QuadReal.

Role Description:


Support scenario modelling, cash flow forecasting, leverage and liquidity analysis through Anaplan, supplemented by ad-hoc financial models as needed, using AI-assisted development for efficiency and quality control
Analyze portfolio exposures, return attribution, and market trends, and support the development of presentation materials with AIenhanced insights and visualization
Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly and ad hoc management reports for senior management, Board of Directors and BCI
Support real estate debt investment underwriting by providing portfolio impact analysis
Assist with ad hoc research projects for benchmarking, peer analysis, risk analysis, and other relevant topics
Query and extract data from enterprise data platforms to support portfolio reporting and analytics needs
Develop and maintain business logic, portfolio calculations, and data transformation rules that underpin reporting outputs
Serve as the primary business-side liaison to IT and ED&A, translating reporting requirements into data specifications and validating platform outputs
Support data enablement initiatives and ongoing data management and governance priorities across the RE Debt portfolio
Validate and reconcile data collected from different systems using AI-powered anomaly detection to improve data quality and identify process improvement opportunities


Experience And Qualifications:


University degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field) OR a background in Economics, Finance or a related business field. CFA or similar designation is a plus
2–3 years of experience working in a data analyst role, ideally in investment management or real estate.
Analytical – Strong quantitative and analytical skills; detail-oriented and proficient in building and handling complicated data sets.
Excellent communication and presentation skills; demonstrates an ability to effectively communicate and present results that articulate key themes and messages.
Must be able to allocate time effectively and work under pressure to meet tight deadlines, handle multiple demands and competing priorities, and adapt to new ideas and change. Comfortable following direction but also contributing to the direction.
Advanced knowledge of SQL, Power Query, Excel, and Power BI is required. Familiarity with Anaplan or a similar planning tool is an asset. Experience with Tableau or Python is considered a plus.
Proactive approach to leveraging technology for process improvement and analytical enhancement. Comfortable learning and applying new tools, automation techniques, GenAI applications (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot), and advanced analytics platforms to solve complex problems, automate data analysis, rapidly prototype financial models, and deliver higher-quality insights.
Has a questioning frame of mind, asks “why” and challenges the status quo with improvements to drive change when needed.


The expected annualized base salary range for this role is $74,000-$84,000.

The actual salary offered will take into consideration a wide array of factors including, but not limited to, the individual’s skill, experience, education and training, the market compensation of the role, and the consideration to internal equity.

We value diverse experiences and perspectives. Even if your skills don’t align 100% with the listed qualifications or salary range, we encourage you to apply – you may be a great fit for this role or others in our community. Applicants may also be considered for alternative positions within the organization where their qualifications and experience align more closely with available opportunities.

We use artificial intelligence (AI) technology — alongside human review — to assist in screening and assessing applicants for this position. Our recruitment team remains involved in all decisions.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada as the company does not provide work permit sponsorship for this role.

Note to Recruiters: QuadReal does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Any unsolicited resumes sent to QuadReal, directly or indirectly, will be considered QuadReal property. QuadReal will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. A recruiting agency must first have a valid, written and fully executed agency agreement contract for engaged services to submit resumes.

QuadReal Property Group will provide reasonable accommodation at any time throughout the hiring process for applicants with disabilities or for those needing job postings in an alternate format. If you require accommodation, please advise the Talent Acquisition team member you are working with and include the following: Job posting #, your name and your preferred method of contact.

Title: Research Data Technologist
Description:
Job Title

Research Data Technologist

Job Category

Non Union Technicians and Research Assistants

Job Profile

Non Union Salaried - Research Assistant /Technician 3

Job Family Group

Staff - Non Union

Department

Keown Laboratory Division of Nephrology | Department of Medicine | Faculty of Medicine

Compensation Range

$4,845.17 - $5,713.66 CAD Monthly

Job End Date

March 31, 2027

Posting End Date

October 23, 2026

Note: Applications will be accepted until 11:59 PM on the Posting End Date.

Please note this is a one (1) year fixed term position. However, there is a possibility of renewal.

At UBC, we believe that attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce is key to the successful pursuit of excellence in research, innovation, and learning for all faculty, staff and students. Our commitment to employment equity helps achieve inclusion and fairness, brings rich diversity to UBC as a workplace, and creates the necessary conditions for a rewarding career.

Job Summary

The Research Data Technologist will work as a member of an interdisciplinary team including clinicians, research scientists, statisticians, software developers, and trainees at UBC and collaborating institutions. The incumbent will support research activities by organizing, processing, analysing, and reporting biomedical data under the direction of senior research team members. In addition, they will support the preparation, quality control, analysis, and interpretation of biomedical datasets, including clinical, molecular, genomic, and imaging data. The incumbent will use established analytical methods and software tools and contribute to data organization, visualization, reporting, and other research activities supporting translational research projects. The incumbent will participate in projects involving data processing, visualization, clinical data integration, and selected applications of statistical and computational methods. Work will be performed using established procedures and under the guidance of senior members of the research team.

The Department of Medicine provides excellence in research, teaching, and clinical services related to the nature, cause, and prevention of adult diseases. As the largest Department in the Faculty of Medicine, comprising 18 Divisions and more than 1,200 faculty and staff located throughout British Columbia, the Department is committed to fostering research excellence, supporting learners and faculty, and contributing to the health of the Province of British Columbia.

Organizational Status

The successful candidate will report to the Principal Investigator (Dr. Paul Keown), with day-to-day oversight provided by the Research Associate, Data Manager and/or senior research team members. The Research Data Technologist will work as a member of an interdisciplinary team including clinicians, research scientists, statisticians, and trainees at UBC and collaborating institutions. The Research Data Technologist will receive direction and training appropriate to assigned projects and will provide regular updates on assigned activities and findings, with the day-to-day oversight given by the Research Associate in the Division of Nephrology, Department of Medicine

Work Performed


Perform routine data preparation, cleaning, quality checks, and organization for biomedical research datasets.
Use established analytical methods, software tools, and procedures to support research data analysis.
Prepare datasets and analysis outputs for use by researchers, statisticians, and other members of the research team.
Support the processing, quality control, integration, and management of molecular, genomic, clinical, and imaging data.
Develop or modify basic scripts, spreadsheets, and analytical tools to support data processing, visualization, and reporting.
Assist with the application of statistical, machine learning, or other computational methods under the direction of senior team members.
Support data visualization, image analysis, and other analytical activities as required by research projects.
Assist with maintaining research data files, analysis environments, and related computational resources.
Work with researchers and other team members to clarify data requirements and support agreed research activities.
Identify and report data quality issues, workflow problems, or unexpected results to senior research team members.
Assist with testing, documentation, quality assurance, and reproducibility of analyses and data workflows.
Assist with the organization, storage, security, and appropriate handling of research data in accordance with institutional and ethical requirements.
Prepare clear documentation, data summaries, tables, figures, and other research materials.
Assist with established analytical and data management procedures for new and ongoing research projects.
Contribute data summaries, figures, and other materials to scientific reports, presentations, publications, and grant applications.
Maintain familiarity with relevant data analysis tools and procedures and participate in training as required.


Consequence of Error/Judgement

All duties performed by the Research Data Technologist must adhere to data privacy and confidentiality policies, standard operating procedures, and UBC policies. Errors in data handling, analysis, or reporting could affect research results, delay study activities, or compromise data integrity. The Research Data Technologist is expected to follow established procedures and seek guidance from senior research team members when non-routine issues or decisions arise.

Supervision Received

The Research Data Technologist will report to the Principal Investigator (Dr. Paul Keown) with day-to-day oversight provided by the Research Associate. The incumbent may also receive direction from senior research team members and/or senior project co-lead(s), dependent on project. They will also receive necessary training from the Bioinformatician, as well as other members of the research team. The candidate is expected to provide regular research activity updates and present research findings to the team members

Supervision Given

The Research Data Technologist will not have formal supervisory responsibilities. The incumbent may provide basic guidance to students or other team members on routine data procedures when requested.

Minimum Qualifications

Completion of a relevant technical program or a university degree in a relevant discipline and a minimum three years of related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own
Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion


Preferred Qualifications

Education, Training and Experience


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Statistics, Computational Biology, or a related discipline.
Additional training or a Master's degree is considered an asset.
Demonstrated experience in data analysis, research, bioinformatics, statistics, or a related area is preferred.
Experience working with research, healthcare, or scientific datasets is preferred.
Experience in biomedical research, healthcare, genomics, imaging, or related environments is considered an asset.
Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one's own.


Skills And Abilities


Working knowledge of common data analysis and spreadsheet software and/or a programming language such as Python or R.
Ability to clean, organize, and perform basic quality checks on research data.
Ability to use established analytical methods and software tools to support research activities.
Familiarity with data visualization and preparation of tables, figures, and reports.
Familiarity with research databases, data management practices, or biomedical datasets is an asset.
Familiarity with version control or other reproducible research practices is an asset.
Ability to follow established procedures for data privacy, confidentiality, and responsible data stewardship.
Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical team members.
Demonstrated ability to work independently on assigned tasks and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
Strong organizational, problem-solving, and time management skills.
Ability to manage assigned tasks and meet established deadlines.

At UBC, we believe that attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce is key to the successful pursuit of excellence in research, innovation, and learning for all faculty, staff and students. Our commitment to employment equity helps achieve inclusion and fairness, brings rich diversity to UBC as a workplace, and creates the necessary conditions for a rewarding career.

Job Summary

The Research Data Technologist will work as a member of an interdisciplinary team including clinicians, research scientists, statisticians, software developers, and trainees at UBC and collaborating institutions. The incumbent will support research activities by organizing, processing, analysing, and reporting biomedical data under the direction of senior research team members. In addition, they will support the preparation, quality control, analysis, and interpretation of biomedical datasets, including clinical, molecular, genomic, and imaging data. The incumbent will use established analytical methods and software tools and contribute to data organization, visualization, reporting, and other research activities supporting translational research projects. The incumbent will participate in projects involving data processing, visualization, clinical data integration, and selected applications of statistical and computational methods. Work will be performed using established procedures and under the guidance of senior members of the research team.

The Department of Medicine provides excellence in research, teaching, and clinical services related to the nature, cause, and prevention of adult diseases. As the largest Department in the Faculty of Medicine, comprising 18 Divisions and more than 1,200 faculty and staff located throughout British Columbia, the Department is committed to fostering research excellence, supporting learners and faculty, and contributing to the health of the Province of British Columbia.

Organizational Status

The successful candidate will report to the Principal Investigator (Dr. Paul Keown), with day-to-day oversight provided by the Research Associate, Data Manager and/or senior research team members. The Research Data Technologist will work as a member of an interdisciplinary team including clinicians, research scientists, statisticians, and trainees at UBC and collaborating institutions. The Research Data Technologist will receive direction and training appropriate to assigned projects and will provide regular updates on assigned activities and findings, with the day-to-day oversight given by the Research Associate in the Division of Nephrology, Department of Medicine

Work Performed

  • Perform routine data preparation, cleaning, quality checks, and organization for biomedical research datasets.
  • Use established analytical methods, software tools, and procedures to support research data analysis.
  • Prepare datasets and analysis outputs for use by researchers, statisticians, and other members of the research team.
  • Support the processing, quality control, integration, and management of molecular, genomic, clinical, and imaging data.
  • Develop or modify basic scripts, spreadsheets, and analytical tools to support data processing, visualization, and reporting.
  • Assist with the application of statistical, machine learning, or other computational methods under the direction of senior team members.
  • Support data visualization, image analysis, and other analytical activities as required by research projects.
  • Assist with maintaining research data files, analysis environments, and related computational resources.
  • Work with researchers and other team members to clarify data requirements and support agreed research activities.
  • Identify and report data quality issues, workflow problems, or unexpected results to senior research team members.
  • Assist with testing, documentation, quality assurance, and reproducibility of analyses and data workflows.
  • Assist with the organization, storage, security, and appropriate handling of research data in accordance with institutional and ethical requirements.
  • Prepare clear documentation, data summaries, tables, figures, and other research materials.
  • Assist with established analytical and data management procedures for new and ongoing research projects.
  • Contribute data summaries, figures, and other materials to scientific reports, presentations, publications, and grant applications.
  • Maintain familiarity with relevant data analysis tools and procedures and participate in training as required.

Consequence of Error/Judgement

All duties performed by the Research Data Technologist must adhere to data privacy and confidentiality policies, standard operating procedures, and UBC policies. Errors in data handling, analysis, or reporting could affect research results, delay study activities, or compromise data integrity. The Research Data Technologist is expected to follow established procedures and seek guidance from senior research team members when non-routine issues or decisions arise.

Supervision Received

The Research Data Technologist will report to the Principal Investigator (Dr. Paul Keown) with day-to-day oversight provided by the Research Associate. The incumbent may also receive direction from senior research team members and/or senior project co-lead(s), dependent on project. They will also receive necessary training from the Bioinformatician, as well as other members of the research team. The candidate is expected to provide regular research activity updates and present research findings to the team members

Supervision Given

The Research Data Technologist will not have formal supervisory responsibilities. The incumbent may provide basic guidance to students or other team members on routine data procedures when requested.

Minimum Qualifications

Completion of a relevant technical program or a university degree in a relevant discipline and a minimum three years of related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own
  • Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion

Preferred Qualifications

Education, Training and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Statistics, Computational Biology, or a related discipline.
  • Additional training or a Master's degree is considered an asset.
  • Demonstrated experience in data analysis, research, bioinformatics, statistics, or a related area is preferred.
  • Experience working with research, healthcare, or scientific datasets is preferred.
  • Experience in biomedical research, healthcare, genomics, imaging, or related environments is considered an asset.
  • Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one's own.

Skills And Abilities

  • Working knowledge of common data analysis and spreadsheet software and/or a programming language such as Python or R.
  • Ability to clean, organize, and perform basic quality checks on research data.
  • Ability to use established analytical methods and software tools to support research activities.
  • Familiarity with data visualization and preparation of tables, figures, and reports.
  • Familiarity with research databases, data management practices, or biomedical datasets is an asset.
  • Familiarity with version control or other reproducible research practices is an asset.
  • Ability to follow established procedures for data privacy, confidentiality, and responsible data stewardship.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical team members.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently on assigned tasks and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage assigned tasks and meet established deadlines.
  • Commitment to privacy, confidentiality, and responsible data stewardship.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
  • Commitment to privacy, confidentiality, and responsible data stewardship.

Title: Principal Resource Geologist
Description:
Location: Vancouver, BC, Canada

Employment Type: Regular Full Time

Workplace Type: Hybrid

About Our Vancouver Office

Located in the heart of downtown Vancouver, between the Pacific Ocean and the Coast Mountains, Teck’s Corporate Office sits in one of Canada’s most culturally diverse cities.

Surrounded by world-renowned nature and globally inspired cuisine, the office brings together many of Teck’s corporate functions - all working toward Teck’s purpose of providing the essential resources the world relies on.

Role Overview

Strategic Planning (SP) at Highland Valley Copper (HVC) is responsible for ensuring the long-term (3+ year) value and resiliency of the operation. The Geology function within SP provides authoritative geological and resource knowledge across all four pits to ensure optimal extraction of value across the full mining value chain.

As Principal Resource Geologist, you are the technical authority and accountable owner of the HVC Mineral Resource Models. You provide oversight, assurance, and governance for resource model development, updates, and application, ensuring models are technically robust, auditable, fit-for-purpose, and consistently applied across Life of Asset (LOA) planning, reserves, mine planning, and strategic decision-making.

This role extends beyond model construction to include coordination and alignment with downstream users of the models—including planning, engineering, operations, metallurgy, and projects—to ensure correct interpretation, appropriate use, and clear communication of uncertainty and risk. You will set standards, define workflows and expectations, and ensure consistency in how resource models inform business decisions at HVC.

You are a recognized technical leader with deep expertise in geostatistics, estimation, and complex porphyry systems, combined with the judgment and influence required to guide high-impact decisions. You are expected to mentor senior practitioners, and influence across disciplines.

This position reports to the Chief Geologist - HVC, SP Geology, and is based in Vancouver, BC, with the option to work remotely up to two days per week. Regular travel to HVC is required (approximately 1 week every 4–6 weeks, with additional travel as business needs dictate).

Key Responsibilities

Safety & Leadership


Act as a courageous and visible safety leader by actively promoting, endorsing, and role-modeling Teck’s safety, environmental, and sustainability values in all interactions and decisions
Take proactive ownership of safety performance by identifying improvement opportunities, engaging stakeholders, and driving actions through to measurable outcomes
Actively participate in safety conversations, field engagements, and risk assessments to reinforce a strong safety culture
Embed safety, hazard awareness, and risk-based thinking into all geological modelling activities, workflows, and decision-support processes


Technical Authority & Governance


Serve as the technical authority for Mineral Resource Models at HVC, accountable for methodology selection, assumptions, validation, and model integrity
Establish, maintain, and evolve standards, guidelines, and best practices for resource modelling, estimation, and classification at HVC
Provide technical sign-off and assurance for resource models used in LOA planning, strategic studies, projects, and public disclosure.


Resource & Reserve Oversight


Provide senior leadership and technical oversight of the annual Resource and Reserve (R&R) process, ensuring compliance with internal standards and external reporting codes
Interface with Qualified Persons, auditors, and reviewers, addressing technical challenges and defending methodologies and outcomes


Cross-Functional Coordination & Model Use


Lead engagement with mine planning, engineering, metallurgy, operations, and projects teams to ensure appropriate and consistent use of resource models
Clearly communicate model assumptions, limitations, uncertainty, and risk to non-geologists to support informed business decisions
Resolve technical misalignment between resource models and downstream applications


Geological Understanding & Model Evolution


Maintain and continuously refine a deep understanding of the HVC mineral system and its spatial, geological, and metallurgical controls
Oversee the integration of geology, structure, geochemistry, geophysics, geometallurgy, and production reconciliation into evolving models
Guide decisions on model resolution, estimation approaches, and classification strategies aligned with business objectives


Innovation & Continuous Improvement


Champion the adoption of advanced and fit-for-purpose modelling approaches, including rapid modelling workflows, conditional simulation, uncertainty analysis, and scenario evaluation
Evaluate advanced modelling and planning techniques leading piloting and implementation where value is demonstrated


Strategic Programs & Advisory Role


Provide senior technical input into the design and prioritization of resource confidence, geometallurgical, geotechnical, and expansion/exploration programs
Act as a trusted advisor to Strategic Planning and site leadership on resource-related risks, opportunities, and trade-offs


Capability Building & Mentorship


Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and coaching to senior and developing geoscientists across HVC and Teck
Build organizational capability by sharing knowledge, reviewing work, and fostering a culture of inclusive technical excellence and rigor.


Qualifications


Degree in Geoscience or a related discipline (e.g., geostatistics, geometallurgy, geochemistry). MSc or PhD strongly preferred;
Registered Professional Geoscientist (or eligible) with Engineers and Geoscientists British Columbia
12+ years of progressive experience in resource geology within mining operations, advanced projects, or applied research, including significant experience at a senior level;
Demonstrated accountability for complex resource models supporting LOA planning, reserves, and strategic investment decisions
Expert-level understanding of geostatistics, estimation theory, resource classification, and uncertainty management
Advanced proficiency in 3D geological modelling and estimation software (Leapfrog GEO, EDGE required; Vulcan or equivalent an asset)
Extensive experience with porphyry copper deposits and large, complex open pit operations
Strong background in geochemistry and integrated multi-disciplinary data analysis across the mining value chain
Advanced quantitative and analytical skills, including expert use of R, Python, ioGAS, or similar tools; experience applying data science or machine learning techniques to geological problems is an asset
Proven ability to influence without authority and operate effectively across disciplines and organizational boundariesExceptional written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.


Leadership Competencies


Demonstrates visible leadership in health, safety, environment, community, and sustainability
Proven ability to build cross-functional partnerships through collaborative influence and constructive feedback, ensuring stakeholders feel supported
Demonstrates emotional intelligence while challenging the status quo to ensure a culture of mutual respect
Acts with integrity, sound judgment, and accountability, setting the technical and ethical standard for others
Thinks strategically, balancing technical rigor with business value and practicality
Drives results through influence, prioritization, and disciplined execution
Understands and navigates organizational systems, processes, and governance to achieve outcomes.


Pay Range: CAD $138,000 - $170,000 per year

The actual amount offered is determined based on the successful candidate’s relevant experience, skills, and competencies and considers internal equity.

Why Teck

At Teck, your work matters—to the world, to our communities and to your future.

As a leading Canadian resource company, we focus on responsibly providing the metals essential for global development and the energy transition while caring for the people, communities and land that we love. We do this guided by our values that, together, form The Teck Way. At Teck, you’ll find purpose-driven work, a culture of respect and inclusion, and the opportunity to grow your career while helping build a better world.

Apply with us

Take the next step in your career by applying for the Principal Resource Geologist role. We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply, even if your background doesn’t match every requirement. We value diversity and are committed to an inclusive, barrier-free hiring process. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request.

Title: System Optimization Specialist Engineer (FTT)
Description:
Job Location: Edmonds, Burnaby, BC (Lower Mainland)

Employment type: Temporary, Full-time (37.5 hrs/wk), approximately 14 months (until about December 2027)

Flexible Work Role: Hybrid

Annual Salary: $131,100.00 - $165,800.00

Requisition: 52518811

A workplace powered by you

At BC Hydro, we're working towards creating a cleaner and more sustainable future for all British Columbians and need people like you to help us. A career at BC Hydro is meaningful and provides you the opportunity to be part of a talented, inclusive, and diverse team. We offer a healthy work-life balance, competitive wages, a comprehensive benefits package, and training opportunities to support you in your career growth. We're proud to be ranked as one of B.C.'s Top Employers and one of Canada's Best Diversity Employers.

What you'll do

Generation System Operations (GSO) is providing an exciting 14 month rotation opportunity to work with our experienced engineers within the System Optimization group.

BC Hydro operates a 13,200 MW system of hydroelectric, thermal, and market resources. Within Generation System Operations (GSO), energy, capacity, and water planning are managed by teams organized by planning time horizons from real time to five years.

In GSO, the System Optimization (SO) group of ten engineers plans the optimal use of energy and capacity for our major reservoirs and generation assets to meet domestic load and inform Powerex trade flexibility. The SO team holds a unique role, liaising with and informing decisions across multiple BC Hydro business lines: Operations Stations and Transmission, Energy Planning, Project Delivery, Regulatory, Finance, Customer and Corporate Affairs, and our trade subsidiary, Powerex. The SO team reports out, monthly, to VP of Operations and our CFO.

The System Optimization engineers plan our monthly to 5-year energy supply forecasts and our within monthly load resource balance options considering uncertainty associated with our surplus or deficit energy positions. The SO modellers are the touchpoint between Powerex, Finance, and Operations for energy management strategies, the operational balance between our major reservoir systems, Peace and Columbia, and optimization of our consolidated net revenue of operations. Critical to these functions is the SO team's responsibility for supporting and developing new planning tools for system energy optimization and managing data analytics.

System Optimization Responsibilities:

Develop, document, and maintain proprietary models and software used to analyze, optimize, and simulate the physical and economic operation of BC Hydro's integrated generation assets: Hydro with reservoir storage, run of river hydro, wind, and thermal.
Work directly with our wholesale electricity traders (Powerex), with GSO's 24/7 operations team (PSOSE) and Operation Planning Engineers (OPEs), field outage schedulers, Corporate Finance, Regulatory, Energy Planning, Load Forecasting, and Project Delivery to optimize generation, reservoir storage, and outage planning.
Optimize system energy production and storage considering uncertainty in system loads, reservoir inflows, outages, Energy Purchase Agreements, and market prices. Provide direction on setting the marginal values for energy stored in our large hydroelectric reservoirs.
Integrate system planning for BC Hydro's largest generation and storage systems, the Peace and Columbia, including planning operations under the Columbia River Treaty.
Inform and plan to manage energy and capacity deficit and surplus positions under short term time horizons (daily to 6 months) with PSOSE, Powerex, and Stations and Field Operations. Provide scenarios for financial and reliability analysis associated with major outage planning, evolving system issues and policy alternatives. Analyze input data sources and model results for relevancy, reliability, and validity.
Prepare and present monthly reports and advice to the Executive and finance related to system modeling, security of energy supply, financial forecasts, and risk. Communicate and problem solve effectively with BC Hydro VP, Directors, engineers, market traders, finance, software consultants, and other staff, both within BC Hydro and externally, for the purposes of gathering and relaying information and resolving new issues of concern.

What you bring

Engineering degree recognized by Canadian Universities and registered, or eligible for immediate registration, as a Professional Engineer with EGBC.
Applicant may be hired as a Senior Engineer (8+ years) or Specialist Engineer (10+ years) depending on level of experience in the following areas: Software development; Economic modeling and analysis; Stochastic programming and/or development of optimization software; Storage based hydroelectric management and modelling; Generation and Transmission outage planning and dispatch; and/or Graduate degree(s) or equivalent experience in Water Resource Management, Applied Mathematics or Economics with specialization in optimization of Energy Systems, Energy Markets, and/or Finance.
Applied programming background in Java and/or R. Experience in data analytics & regression model development and data transformations. Experience in reporting and enterprise data management platforms (Power BI, Fabric, etc.).
Ability to make decisions in tight time frames and under pressure, while working with an extensive array of decision support models. Able to apply creative and critical problem solving to emerging issues. Able to multi-task and set priorities to achieve long term goals.
Engaging interpersonal, oral, and written technical communication and presentation skills.
Ability to provide direct or indirect work leadership to engineers and other technical stakeholders and Project Delivery on water conveyance and generation management.

What we offer

A comprehensive benefits package
A minimum of 15 paid vacation days
A lifetime pension
Flexible work model, depending on your role type
Training and development courses

For more information on the benefits we offer, visit bchydro.com/benefits.

What else you should know

This is a temporary opportunity until approximately December 2027.
Applicants who do not meet full qualifications or those with lesser work experience may be considered for a lower level position.

Please be advised that this role has been assessed as safety sensitive and pre-qualification alcohol and drug testing will be required as a pre-condition to employment.

How to apply

Apply online by October 12, 2026: view and apply for this job on the BC Hydro Careers site.

BC Hydro is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified job seekers. If you're a person with a disability, please let us know by emailing RecruitmentHelp@bchydro.com, as adjustments can be made to help support you in your application process.

Title: Machine learning Engineer
Description:
Job Description

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you'll design and implement scalable, high-performance machine learning systems to support DeviantArt's vibrant online community. You'll play a key role in building innovative solutions that enhance user experiences and foster creativity within a high-traffic environment.


Develop and improve algorithms for recommendations and classification to enhance user experiences
Implement and deploy reliable machine learning systems for an active online art community
Build end-to-end systems, from data ingestion to serving results in production
Stay up-to-date with developments in data and machine learning engineering, applying them to DeviantArt systems and goals


Qualifications


5+ years of experience in Machine Learning or closely related disciplines
Understanding of machine learning algorithms, especially for recommendation and classification
Experience designing and deploying cloud-based production systems
Expertise with large-scale data processing and machine learning infrastructure
Familiarity with Python and technologies like Apache Spark, AWS, and PyTorch
Knowledge of large language models and their applications to recommendation and classification
Experience with serverless approaches or large-scale search engines like Elasticsearch or Vespa – an advantage


This is a hybrid position, and the team is expected to come to the office 1 day per week.

Additional Information

The DeviantArt Artificial Intelligence team is part of DeviantArt, the largest online social network for artists and art enthusiasts. Founded in 2000 and part of Wix since 2017, DeviantArt empowers artists to exhibit, promote, and share their works with an enthusiastic, art-centric community. With over 115 million registered users and tens of thousands of original art pieces uploaded daily, DeviantArt fosters creativity and community. The Artificial Intelligence team focuses on developing innovative solutions to enhance user experience, support artistic creativity, and ensure safe interactions within the platform.

We believe the best innovation happens when we mix deep focus work with in-person connection. While you'll work from home most of the week, we require this person to be in our Vancouver office every Thursday.

The approximate base compensation is $165,000 - 200,000 CAD In addition to base pay you will receive company RSUs as part of the compensation package.

The final offer may vary and will be determined by various factors including candidate profile and ideal qualifications.


Location: Candidates must be currently located in the Greater Vancouver Area, BC.
Work Authorization: Candidates must possess current, valid work authorization to work legally in Canada without requiring employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

Do you want to be part of the team which is reinventing Enterprise Financials for the agentic age? The Financials Hyper Automation AI team is a small, advanced team of ML engineers charged with re-envisioning and building the next generation of ERP Financial and Accounting systems. We have an entrepreneurial mindset with a focus on creating delightful, intelligent experiences, leveraging the state-of-the-art in AI as well as strong, proven techniques from conventional machine learning. Working closely with product managers, we build advanced prototypes as well as deploy full production-grade features to solve our customer’s most pressing business challenges. Our current areas of development include strong reasoning agents for complex financial workflows and agentic self-improvement.

About The Role

As a ML Engineer on the FIN Hyperautomation AI team, you will develop intelligent user experiences powered by advanced tools like (but not limited to) generative AI. You will work with other engineers to deliver ML solutions across Workday’s ML infrastructure, from training ML models to developing APIs, as well as managing the lifecycle of such products and services. You will be backed by Workday’s vast computing resources and rich datasets, to deliver transformative value to our customers.

Your specific responsibilities include:


Own exploration, design, implementation, and deployment of features.
The evaluation, scalability, and observability of these features.
Apply ML techniques, including LLMs and natural language understanding, to intelligently process business documents and, for example, automate critical customer workflows.
Stay up to date with advancements in AI, LLMs, RAG, autonomous agents and orchestration frameworks to drive innovation.
Serve as a technical role model for more junior engineers


Sound like your kind of challenge?

About You

Basic Qualifications:


5+ years experience as a member of a data science, machine learning engineering, or other relevant software development team building applied machine learning products at scale, including taking products through applied research, design, implementation, production, and production-based evaluation.
5+ years of professional experience with Python and supporting numeric libraries, with experience in shipping production code and models
5+ years of professional experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP, etc.)
Bachelor’s (Master’s or PhD preferred) degree in engineering, data/computer science, physics, math or equivalent.


Other Qualifications:


5+ years of professional experience in building information retrieval systems
5+ years of professional experience building scalable, production-level ML services on platforms such as Kubernetes.
5+ years of professional experience in ML and deep learning frameworks & toolkits, such as scikit-learn, Pandas, PySpark, Pytorch, TensorFlow.
3+ years of professional experience in developing with LLMs, RAG, and AI agents.
Strong understanding of statistical analysis, ML paradigms and algorithms, and natural language processing, with a focus for information retrieval and/or recommendation system use cases.
Professional experience in independently solving ambiguous, open-ended problems and technically leading a team.
